scope: All substantive sources cited in authored documentation and adopted sources in the preserved provenance/search records. Repeated links to the same source are grouped; title-screened exclusions are search history, not adopted evidence.
limits: Current source checks occurred on 2026-10-21 UTC for the 2026-10-20 local-date review.
Matching metadata does not establish claim support. Access levels record this pass only; prior full-text retrieval records are preserved without being claimed as repeated.
No external tool benchmark, exhaustive systematic review, or independent biological validation was performed.

references.title: Conservation of an RNA regulatory map between Drosophila and mammals.
supported_claims: Source experiment studied Pasilla-dependent RNA processing and compared regulation with mammalian NOVA proteins.
limitations: Primary full text could not be reopened in this review; PMC verification pages or publisher access errors limited current appraisal to PubMed metadata and abstract.
The documented article/package sample-allocation discrepancy remains unresolved; current abstract access cannot resolve it.
corrections: Completed issue, page range, and PMID; retained 2011 issue year rather than 2010 online year.

references.title: Moderated estimation of fold change and dispersion for RNA-seq data with DESeq2.
references.authors: Love MI, Huber W, Anders S.
supported_claims: Count variability and normalization are distinct from full negative-binomial differential-expression modeling.
Specialized count transformations address mean–variance behavior.
limitations: Publisher methods and relevant passages inspected; no DESeq2 execution or independent validation performed.

references.title: Differential expression analysis for sequence count data.
supported_claims: Geometric reference and median-ratio scaling motivate relative normalization.
Count variability requires an inferential model beyond descriptive PCA.
limitations: The precise current log-median convention was additionally checked in pinned DESeq2 source; the full DESeq model is not implemented.

references.title: A scaling normalization method for differential expression analysis of RNA-seq data.
supported_claims: RNA composition can make library totals a misleading relative scale.
limitations: TMM is contextual evidence; this project does not implement it or compare its performance.

references.title: A generalized solution of the orthogonal Procrustes problem.
supported_claims: Retained historical attribution for orthogonal Procrustes; no new source-content verification claimed.
limitations: DOI and bibliographic metadata cross-checked against available search records, but the primary publisher page could not be retrieved.
The independently written SVD calculation was inspected and tested; that is not a substitute for primary-text access.

references.title: The seeker R package: simplified fetching and processing of transcriptome data.
supported_claims: The software provides a standardized interface to transcriptome fetching and processing, with logging.
limitations: Primary full text could not be reopened in this review; PMC verification pages or publisher access errors limited current appraisal to PubMed metadata and abstract.
Earlier full-body appraisal is retained as historical review history, not represented as repeated in this review.

references.title: SampleExplorer: using language models to discover relevant transcriptome data.
supported_claims: Language-model-based search can retrieve transcriptome samples from metadata.
limitations: Primary full text could not be reopened in this review; PMC verification pages or publisher access errors limited current appraisal to PubMed metadata and abstract.
Retrieval relevance does not authenticate experimental sample labels.
corrections: Specified 2025 issue year, with online publication on 26 December 2024 distinguished in the bibliography.

references.title: pasilla: data package with per-exon and per-gene read counts
supported_claims: Package purpose, authorship, citation DOI, and current release version.
limitations: The live release page is not the version used for bundled inputs.

references.title: pasilla source snapshot: DESCRIPTION and bundled data
supported_claims: Pinned DESCRIPTION gives version 1.41.0, source experiment attribution, and unqualified LGPL declaration.
limitations: Source-mirror snapshot is distinct from the moving release page; no new license version is inferred from unqualified LGPL.

references.title: Data preprocessing and creation of the data objects pasillaGenes and pasillaExons
supported_claims: The displayed sample table labels three treated and four untreated libraries, with single-read and paired-end data.
The package derives processed counts from the source RNA-seq experiment.
limitations: A derived annotation is not independent evidence resolving the original study allocation discrepancy.

references.title: Analyzing RNA-seq data with DESeq2
references.authors: Love MI, Anders S, Huber W.
supported_claims: Distinguishes exploratory transformations from inferential count modeling.
Perfect confounding or missing factor combinations can make the design matrix non-full-rank.
limitations: Documentation is not a demonstration that this project ran DESeq2 or validated its biological conclusions.

references.title: DESeq2 core.R: estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix
supported_claims: The ratio estimator exponentiates a median of finite log ratios; reference genes with nonfinite geometric means are excluded.
limitations: Inspected relevant function, not the complete codebase. The Python implementation separately centers factors and fixes reference depth.

references.title: seeker README and DESCRIPTION
supported_claims: Standard interface and detailed logging are declared; DESCRIPTION identifies version and dependencies.
limitations: No execution or code copying; only the named files were inspected.

references.title: math.isclose: relative and absolute tolerance comparison
supported_claims: Defines the finite-number comparison formula used by the comparator.
limitations: Does not justify any particular scientific tolerance.

references.title: json: JSON encoder and decoder
supported_claims: Default handling of nonfinite constants and duplicate object names can be changed using parsing hooks.
limitations: JSON parsing alone is not validation of scientific data.

references.title: ps: pasilla, Drosophila melanogaster (Gene ID 44258)
supported_claims: Retained gene-record link for background annotation; current content could not be rechecked.
limitations: The primary page returned a browser-verification screen. The source experiment independently supports the general Pasilla RNA-regulation context.
